svg.text: owner Jaydev · Verilog-2001 + FPGA primitives · parameter HW_ONLY (1 for the phase-1 bitstream) · NOT part of the GDSII
Connects the real board (clock, buttons, switches, LEDs, I²C pads, motor-driver header) to ecu_soc_top. It does NOT synchronise inputs (ACR-1): raw pins go straight in.
inout → GY-521 (MPU-6050), 4.7 k pull-ups to 3.3 V
▸ LED and pin buffers, I/O standards, XDC
ASIC: pad ring + clock pad / PLL macro replace this file.
Pin table (fill in for your board, LVCMOS33): every port above gets one pin; clock constraint 20 ns on the 50 MHz clock. Never connect 5 V to FPGA pins.
Phase-1 bitstream: HW_ONLY = 1. Final: HW_ONLY = 0 and the CPU configures everything.
